description: Experience the true taste of Italy with this exquisite Spaghetti alle Vongole, featuring plump Manila clams bathed in a fragrant white wine and garlic sauce. This classic seafood pasta is surprisingly simple to prepare, delivering a fresh and vibrant flavor that transports you straight to the Italian coast. Enjoy a delightful meal that is both elegant and comforting, perfect for any occasion.

instructions.title: Prepare the Clams
instructions.text: Start by purging the clams if not already done. Place them in a bowl of cold salted water for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours, changing the water once or twice. Discard any clams that are open and do not close when tapped. Rinse thoroughly under cold water.

instructions.title: Cook the Spaghetti
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a rolling boil. Add the spaghetti and cook according to package directions until al dente. Reserve about 1 cup of the pasta cooking water before draining the spaghetti. Do not rinse the pasta.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wide pot over medium heat. Add the sliced garlic and red pepper flakes. Sauté gently for 2-3 minutes until the garlic is fragrant and lightly golden, being careful not to burn it.

instructions.title: Steam the Clams
instructions.text: Increase the heat to medium-high. Add the cleaned clams to the skillet and pour in the white wine. Cover the skillet tightly with a lid and cook for 5-7 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, until all the clams have opened. Discard any clams that remain closed.

instructions.title: Combine Pasta and Sauce
instructions.text: Add the drained spaghetti directly to the skillet with the opened clams and their liquid. Toss everything together vigorously. Add half of the chopped fresh parsley and about half a cup of the reserved pasta cooking water. Continue to toss, allowing the pasta to absorb the flavors and create a light sauce. Add more pasta water if needed to achieve a desired consistency.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and freshly ground black pepper if necessary. The clam liquid is naturally salty, so be mindful. Stir in the remaining fresh parsley. Drizzle with a little extra virgin olive oil just before serving. Serve immediately in warm bowls.

tips: Always purge your clams thoroughly to remove any sand, ensuring a grit-free and enjoyable dish. A good soak in salted water makes all the difference.
Do not overcook the pasta; it should be al dente as it will finish cooking in the clam sauce, absorbing all the wonderful flavors.
Reserve pasta water! It is your secret weapon to emulsify the sauce and create that perfect, silky texture that coats every strand of spaghetti beautifully.
